title: Normal ordering in string theory and the canonical phase space quantization
summary: We consider quantization techniques with a particular emphasis on the phase space quantization, as encountered in quasi-probabilistic descriptions and in string theory. We investigate what is lost by adopting the normal ordering prescription, by revisiting fundamental quantization concepts and the correspondence rules that define the well-known quasi-distributions: the Wigner, Q, and P functions, some of which are inherently ordering dependent. The actual quantum state dictates the necessity of employing discrete countable structures or, alternatively, the complex phase space formulation…
